name: Hudson Rock Cavalier free OSINT tools (infostealer exposure metadata)
tier_rationale: Identifiable cybercrime-intelligence company, but its free OSINT tools publish no terms of use (P134 chair: tier community, terms unknown).

reliability.justification: Infostealer-log metadata from criminal markets: an exposure indicator, not proof; common usernames and test addresses match many unrelated machines (P134 cond 6).

error_markers.reason: Hudson Rock: error field in a 200 answer (could not verify)
Hudson Rock: rate limited (message inside a 200 answer)

search_by_email.title: Cavalier osint-tools/search-by-email?email= (per-person, run_on own_assets)

sanitizer.notes: P134 cond 1-2 ALLOWLIST applied before the HTTP cache, evidence, logs and graph: per stealer only the compromise date, stealer family and the two service counts, at top level only the counts. The message, top_passwords, top_logins, computer_name, ip, malware_path, antiviruses, operating_system and any new field are dropped.

search_by_email.notes: A1 initial class: Hudson Rock free tools = 'unknown' (no published terms; disabled in every profile until Hudson Rock confirms its terms in writing or legal records a licence_allow entry, P134 cond 4). Research C0303 (verified_live 200, test@example.com -> 5 stealers = generic address threshold).

search_by_username.title: Cavalier osint-tools/search-by-username?username= (per-person, typed seeds with --breach-scope all only)
search_by_username.notes: Common usernames return many unrelated machines (research C0303): weighted low, generic threshold applies.

search_by_ip.title: Cavalier osint-tools/search-by-ip?ip= (org_profile CIDRs only)

sanitizer.notes: Same P134 ALLOWLIST as search-by-email (the masked victim IP is dropped).

search_by_ip.notes: P134 cond 7: only for IPs inside org_profile CIDRs.

search_by_domain.title: Cavalier osint-tools/search-by-domain?domain= (stealer domain search, counts only, run_on own_assets_only)

sanitizer.notes: P134 cond 8: counts only (and stealer-family counts). URLs, password-strength statistics, antivirus lists, applications, third-party domains, the logo and the last-compromise dates are dropped.

search_by_domain.notes: Hung for more than 70 s for some domains (research): 30 s request timeout, ERROR 'timeout' = could not verify (P134 cond 10).

urls_by_domain.title: Cavalier osint-tools/urls-by-domain?domain= (URLs seen in infostealer logs, run_on own_assets_only)

sanitizer.notes: P134 cond 5: only the URL rows survive; the module strips query strings, fragments, userinfo and user-identifying path segments (scheme + host + path) in memory and fetches this endpoint no-store, so unstripped URLs never reach the HTTP cache.

urls_by_domain.notes: Attack-surface context only: url entities with expand=False, never contacted automatically (P134 cond 5).

notes: Owned by batch p1-G04-1 (P134 hudson_rock, hudson_rock_domain). Sensitive provider (A4): every source has an allow-list sanitizer; cache TTL <= 7 days; leaked data is never used for login attempts, spraying or validation (A4 BR12).
